style.styleTitle: Scottish Everlastings Ltd Woodland Foliage Christmas Garland
style.toneOfVoice: Bring the lush beauty of the forest into your home with this 180cm woodland greens garland. Expertly crafted with lifelike foliage, this artificial garland captures the rich textures and deep green tones of woodland greenery, creating a natural, timeless decorative accent. Perfect for draping along mantels, staircases, tables, or doorways, its flexible design allows for effortless styling and layering with other decorations. The realistic leaves and full, layered construction give it a vibrant, fresh appearance, adding depth and charm to any space. Measuring 180cm in length, this woodland greens garland is maintenance-free, staying beautiful year after year. An easy and elegant way to bring calming beauty into your home décor. Bring indoors during adverse weather conditions. Garland Length: 180cm.
